saitama.label: Arakawa levee breach BP002 (Saitama)
saitama.notes: Built with navara-flood-zarr ("type": "polygons", with the Re:Earth Terrain raster-dem source as "terrain" for the depth) from https://assets.cms.plateau.reearth.io/assets/c3/2822c1-a99f-46d0-9d73-766b685e2126/11100_saitama-shi_city_2024_flood-simulation_saitama-BP002.czml. Starts a day after the breach, when the water is already spreading; the breach is the CZML's breach point packet.
saitama.attribution: PLATEAU 3D Visualization of Time-Series Flood Simulation by Levee Break Point (Arakawa River System)

minami.label: Tsunami SD07 (Minami, Tokushima)
minami.notes: TRIAL, local only: the data is not published. Built from the GMT grids of tsunami case SD07 ("type": "rasters"), timed as model steps of 0.02 s from the earthquake, with the levels and the ground (hwl) taken to count from the H.W.L., T.P. +0.917 m, the building cells left out, and the flow velocity from its vx and vy grids (vy counts south). Starts 30 min in, with the town flooded.
minami.attribution: Tsunami Simulation Data: Provided by the Earthquake Engineering Laboratory at Tokushima University
